SELECT c.country_code, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM ecom_v1.customers c JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' AND o.order_status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.country_code ORDER BY active_customers DESC, c.country_code ASC

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM ecom_v1.customers c JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' AND o.order_status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment ASC

SELECT
  c.segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM ecom_v1.customers c
JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
  AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment ASC
